strategyPosture: Watch — stand-down in force and deepening: VIX is 31.93 intraday, SPX is about 21 points above the 7,000 escalation trigger, and SMH and NVDA are below their Zone 2 floors with the tally at 1 of 4. No new deployment, no averaging down, and nothing sells into the break; hold existing positions and cash.

themes.counterRead: Rotation inside a correction is still a correction: SPX is 8.52% below its 120-day high at Thursday's close and roughly 10.5% below it intraday, so the index is falling too — just less than its leaders. The rotation read holds only while credit stays calm; HY OAS above 4% or the gap widening past 15 points voids it.
themes.dataAnchor: Mag 7 averages 23.51% below its 52-week highs against SPY 10.4% below, a 13.11-point gap — the weakness is concentrated in the names that dominate the index by weight, with AAPL the strongest at -4.3% and NVDA the weakest at -44.4%. Bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 1.7%, far below the ~40% stress threshold) and HY OAS is 3.52, calm. That combination reads as index-leadership rotation, not a confirmed broad rollover.
themes.label: Rotation, not rollover — Mag 7 leads the fall
themes.narrative: The Mag 7 collapse reads as the whole market breaking: NVDA is down 36.19% over the month and QQQ 11.88%, so the index looks like it is rolling over.
themes.watchFor: Mag 7/SPY gap past 15 points, or HY OAS above 4% — either voids the rotation read.
